intent: Add three director powers - ambush, frenzy and rift - giving the player priced control over enemy placement and a burst tempo lever.
scope: reverse_survivors/src/core/types.ts (PowerKind, costs/cooldowns, EdgeId, DirectorState fields, new DirectorAction variants)
reverse_survivors/src/core/sim.ts (frenzy speed and damage), snapshot.ts, src/ui/SpawnBar.tsx, src/ui/Hud.tsx, src/styles.css
Non-goal: difficulty tiers ship as their own commit
changes: A shared spendPower gate handles cooldown and affordability for all three powers, so each additional power costs no new branches in the dispatcher.

EDGES converted from an array to Record<EdgeId, EdgeFn>: under noUncheckedIndexedAccess an array index would be possibly-undefined and force an unreachable fallback branch, whereas a finite-union Record stays non-optional.

Ambush placement uses a golden-angle step so successive summons never reuse a lane. An earlier 2*PI/7 formulation was caught in review: it silently cycled every 7 summons, with index 7 landing byte-identically on index 0.

Frenzy damage derives from one shared frenzyDamageMul helper. Review caught that an earlier version multiplied contact damage only, leaving enemy projectiles and bomber blasts unscaled - which contradicted the README and left the bomber, whose contactDamage is 0, entirely unaffected.
MOVE_FNS gained a speed parameter so frenzy (and later difficulty) multiply in one place rather than at three call sites.
The README's former promise that enemy placement is never the player's to choose is deliberately reversed here and documented as such.

verification.evidence: 145 tests passed. Coverage 100% on all four metrics: statements 516/516, branches 153/153, functions 96/96, lines 499/499.
24 consecutive ambushes produced 24 distinct spawn positions. Before the golden-angle fix the same probe produced only 7, with index 7 identical to index 0 at (610.0000, 300.0000).
Ratios with frenzy on vs off, measured over 360 ticks: warden contact 1.300, artillery projectile 1.300, stalker projectile 1.300, bomber blast 1.300. Before the fix the last three measured 1.000.

verification.command: RNG-identity check against the pre-change implementation
verification.evidence: The old array-based pick was reimplemented from git HEAD and compared across 50 seeds x 20 calls on both the returned position and the final RNG state: 0 mismatches. Existing seeded replays are unchanged.

risks: Powers are gated by cooldown rather than energy alone, because late-game income reaches 24/s and an energy-only gate would degenerate into spamming the highest-value button.
Ambush lets the director bypass the survivor's kiting AI, which is the intended counter to its late-game power curve but is the most likely thing to need retuning.
rollback: git revert the commit; no persisted state or data migration is involved.
After rollback run `npm run check` in reverse_survivors/ and confirm the suite passes at 100% coverage.
